usage: Chicken is a noun that refers to the bird commonly found on farms.
You can use 'chicken' to talk about the animal itself or dishes made from it.
Chicken can be used as a subject or object in a sentence.
When talking about chickens, you can specify types like 'hen' or 'rooster'.
You can also use chicken in plural form to mean multiple birds, although in Cantonese, quantifiers are usually added.

examples.meaning: Our farm has a lot of chickens.
